# José Leite

> Chief Marketing Officer & AI Automation Architect. 15+ years scaling growth,
> SEO/GEO and n8n automation across LogiTech, Retail, EdTech and Media.
> Based in Barcelona, Spain.

José Leite is a Senior Full-Stack Marketer and AI Automation Architect
specialised in the convergence of Generative AI, automation (n8n), SEO and
GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). Currently CMO at EnvioxEnvio. Previously
Head of SEO & Organic Growth at Kleding/Fashiola, Senior Digital Consultant
at Elabs Consulting, and International Acquisition Manager at Camaloon.

Education: Computer Engineering, Universidade de Coimbra (2002).
Postgraduate Diploma in Marketing, IPAM - The Marketing School.
Certifications: Google Analytics 4 (GA4), HubSpot Inbound Expert,
SAS Marketing Automation.
